recreation_entertainment_activity.label: Recreation / entertainment activity
recreation_entertainment_activity.value: Destination mountain resorts and regional and local ski areas, with skiing, snowboarding, summer mountain activities, golf and resort lodging.

venue_service_capacity.label: Venue / service capacity
venue_service_capacity.value: Worldwide network of destination resorts and regional and local ski areas with lift-served terrain, plus Grand Teton lodge rooms, cabins and campsites.

visits_event_attendance.label: Visits / event attendance
visits_event_attendance.value: High annual skier visit volume across the mountain resort network.

admission_yield.label: Admission yield
admission_yield.value: Effective ticket price is total lift revenue divided by total skier visits.

pass_membership_mix.label: Pass / membership mix
pass_membership_mix.value: Preseason Epic Pass purchases alongside individual lift tickets, with a separate My Epic Gear membership.

seasonality_utilization.label: Seasonality / utilization
seasonality_utilization.value: Winter-led ski and ride operations, with summer mountain activities and golf. Grand Teton lodging operates from late spring through early fall.

notes: Lift throughput and the share of visits or revenue attributable to passes are unclear.
